svg.title: CagriSema weight loss: beats semaglutide alone, loses to Zepbound head-to-head
svg.desc: Average body weight lost, everyone randomized counted. REDEFINE 1, 68 weeks: CagriSema 20.4%, semaglutide alone 14.9%, cagrilintide alone 11.5%, placebo 3.0%. REDEFINE 4, 84 weeks, open-label head-to-head: CagriSema 20.2%, Zepbound 15 mg 23.6%. Sources: NEJM 2025 and Novo Nordisk SEC filing, February 2026.
